notificationPause.title: Pause personal notifications
notificationPause.description: Pause all automatic personal DMs: reminders, followed Twitch and Steam updates, personal digests, anime reminders, Calendar and schedule reminders, and morning briefings.
notificationPause.timezone: Exact date and time in your saved timezone: {timezone}. Leave empty to pause until you resume.
notificationPause.behavior: Your individual settings stay saved. Pending reminders, follows and schedule alerts wait until you resume; digests skip paused runs, and morning briefings resume only within today's delivery window. Public server posts continue.
notificationPause.pausedIndefinitely: All automatic personal notifications are paused until you resume.
notificationPause.pausedUntil: All automatic personal notifications are paused until {date}.
notificationPause.failed: Could not update your notification pause.
